limits: One mean over active token losses per example, followed by the batch mean. These coefficient fractions are not measured gradient-norm fractions or loss-value fractions.

All arms use fixed width640,global32,320updates. Equal updates/shape do not replace measured compute accounting; active token totals are not a FLOP estimate.
This describes the fixed objective before capability review; no weight/objective or success gate was changed.
loss_allocation.coefficient_formula: For each document let P=len(prefix_ids)-1,T=len(full_calculation_ids). Raw view counts(P,16,0,0); prior augmented(P,16,T,2); post augmented(P,16,T,1). Divide each category by that view total, then average over10240 occurrences. Each augmented arm sees one raw and one augmented view per document.
